correctness.rationale: Generic normal-vector support maximizes by assigning the k largest positive coefficients the labels n,n-1,...,n-k+1. Adjacent coefficient switches exchange consecutive labels, length sqrt(2); a coefficient crossing zero inserts/deletes the smallest positive label, length n-k=d+m-k. Their multiplicities are A=((m-2)N+2)/2 and B_j=m!/(j-1)! for j=1..m. Exact combinatorics sum to mN/2 edges and total insertion length m![(d+1)E_(m-1)+E_(m-2)]. Since N~e*m!, substitution gives insertion-length share 2c/(sqrt(2)+2c) for d/m->c (including 0,infinity) and the fixed-d refinement; B_j/(N-1) is the shifted truncated Poisson(1) law, and length-bias decomposes as mixture of 1+Y and 2+Y. Separately recomputed exact factorial edge counts and insertion length sums for m=2..8 with d=0,1,m,2m; those computations only corroborate all-parameter normal-fan proof.
residual_risks: Regularity n>=m is essential to the integer label normal fan; no n<m claim.
